title: Banane Destroyer
description: This mod adds some basic and complicated weapons. Not too much now, but will update soon
body: This adds multiple swords with probably too much damage, a sword that uses MATH for damage scaling, and armor that adapts to any damage type it experiences. This also includes a new weapon called 'Let's go gambling'. It has a random chance from a set pool, so it could give you something or nothing. It also has a small chance to buff the player you are fighting, because gambling. It also adds a void sword, void cookies, and a bulletproof vest(no guns).
